content:
kayla: hey team :wave: first day — where do we keep the team onboarding checklist + templates? tried to edit but Notion says I don't have permission

devex-bot: Hi Kayla! For doc edit access, fill https://intranet.redwood/forms/notion-edit-request or click 'Request Access' on the page. Team templates live under 'Docs Hub > Team Playbooks > Onboarding' — if you need owner-level edit, choose 'Editors' on the form. Ping @devex if urgent.

zane: If it's the 'API quickstart' template, ownership is with eng-docs. I can add you quickly — @kayla give me your email.

kayla: thanks zane, kayla@redwood.ai — also, is there a default onboarding template for engine config runbooks?

jordan: there's a 'Runtime onboarding' template under Playbooks. Copy the template and put it in our workspace. We only grant edit rights to workspace owners, so copying is easiest.

samir: notes: when you copy, update the 'owner' property and set 'doc-type: onboarding' so devex tooling picks it up for the new hire checklist. Also add a changelog block at the top with the date.

carmen: If anyone else hits permission errors, use /request-access or DM me (carmen). I handle quick grants for first-week edits.

kayla: copied and edited — left a comment on the Runtime page for zane to review. thanks all :white_check_mark:

devex-bot: Reminder: Docs triage happens every Wed 10am PT — changes to shared templates should be PR'd in the docs repo or tagged 'template:update' in the page.
